description: Which provisions rely on, cite or use the definitions of this one, on a date: those that cite it, and those that use a term it defines (for example the provisions that use "debtor in possession"), with the definition's scope ("In this subchapter"). Use it before a text search when asked what depends on a provision or its definitions; a change to this provision can change what they mean.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

offset.description: Rows to skip in each group: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision.

name: what_else_changes
title: What else changes
